definitions: Public gardens located in Paris, France, situated in the 16th arrondissement.
Known for their large fountains, sculptures, and panoramic views of the Eiffel Tower.
examples: We spent the afternoon at the Jardins du Trocadéro.
The view of the Eiffel Tower from the Jardins du Trocadéro is iconic.
The Fountains of Warsaw are a prominent feature of the Jardins du Trocadéro.
